parts.name: Root
parts.description: The `<nav>` landmark, named "Breadcrumb" in the locale of `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: children
props.description: `Breadcrumbs.List`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
The name of the landmark. Without it, the name is "Breadcrumb" in the locale of
`LocaleProvider`. Give one when the page has two sets of breadcrumbs.

props.name: maxItems
props.description:
The count of items past which the middle of the trail folds behind a `Breadcrumbs.Ellipsis`.
The first item and the last `maxItems - 1` stay in view. Without it, every item is in view.

props.name: expanded
props.description: True once the user unfolds the trail. Use `bind:expanded` to read it, or to fold it again.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the trail unfolds or folds.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<nav>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

dataAttributes.name: data-collapsed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the middle of the trail is folded.

parts.name: List
parts.description: The `<ol>` of the trail, with `role="list"` in writing. The order of the items is the order of the pages.

props.name: children
props.description: The items.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<ol>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One page of the trail, as an `<li>`. It holds a link, and a separator after the link on every item but the last.

props.name: children
props.description: `Breadcrumbs.Link`, and a `Breadcrumbs.Separator` after it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<li>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.

parts.name: Link
parts.description: The page, as an `<a>` with an `href`, or a `<span>` without one. `current` marks the page the user is on.

props.name: children
props.description: The text of the link.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: href
props.description: The address of the page. Without it, the link is plain text.

props.name: current
props.description:
Marks the page the user is on. The link gets `aria-current="page"`. Set it on the last
item: a screen reader user then knows where the trail ends.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Takes the link out of use: it keeps its text, and it loses its `href` and its tab stop.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<a>` element, or the `<span>` without an `href`. Use `bind:element` to read it.

dataAttributes.name: data-current
dataAttributes.description: Present on the link of the page the user is on.

parts.name: Ellipsis
parts.description: The button that stands for the folded middle of a long trail, in an `<li>`. It renders only while the trail is folded, named "Show N more pages".

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button. Three dots without children.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the button.

props.name: itemClass
props.description: The CSS class names of the `<li>` around the button.

props.name: separator
props.description: The sign after the button, such as a `Breadcrumbs.Separator`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The name of the button. Without it, "Show N more pages" in the locale of `LocaleProvider`.

props.name: element
props.description: The button element, while the trail is folded. Use `bind:element` to read it.

dataAttributes.name: data-breadcrumbs-ellipsis
dataAttributes.description: Present on the `<li>` around the button.

parts.name: Separator
parts.description: The sign between two pages, hidden from the screen reader. A slash without children.

props.name: children
props.description: The sign between two items. A slash without children.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The `<span>` element. Use `bind:element` to read it.
